empty: Open a terminal from an SSH host, or view command output here.
connectHint: Connect only when requested. Each terminal uses an independent SSH connection.
closeHint: Disconnect this interactive session? Remote processes may continue running. This does not stop the remote service.
trustHint: Verify the fingerprint with the server administrator.
clipboardFallback: Use the system copy/paste shortcut in the terminal.
pasteHint: This text may execute multiple commands. Review it before sending.

error.invalidService: Check the service name, host and actions.
error.invalidAction: Check command fields, timeout and exit codes.
error.serviceBusy: Wait for this service’s current task to finish.
error.staleAction: Configuration changed. Reopen and review the action.
error.ruleMissing: A linked forward no longer exists.
error.hostBlocked: Resolve the host configuration diagnostics first.
error.sessionOptions: Session options need attention. Explicitly choose not to send local environment variables for SendEnv.
error.authentication: Authentication failed. Supply credentials to retry before execution.
error.hostKey: Host fingerprint was rejected or changed.
error.connectionTimeout: SSH connection timed out; command was not executed.
error.connectionFailed: SSH connection failed; command was not executed.
error.remoteUnknown: Stopped waiting locally; the remote process state is unknown. Check its state before running again.
error.exitCode: Command returned an unsuccessful exit code.
error.backupFailed: Could not back up the existing configuration.
error.hostUsedByService: This host is referenced by a remote service.
error.unauthorizedWindow: This window cannot execute remote commands.
error.staleSession: Session changed; open a new session.
error.requestExpired: This request has expired; open a new session explicitly.
error.alreadyAttached: Terminal output already has a consumer.
error.inputFailed: Input delivery could not be confirmed. The session was disconnected; remote state may be unknown.
error.outputGap: Terminal output is incomplete. Reconnect instead of restoring an invalid screen.
error.linkFailed: Could not open this web link.
error.negotiationOverflow: Too much output before session acceptance.
error.stillRunning: Wait for the session to disconnect.
error.hostUsedByTerminal: This host is used by an active terminal.

noEnvironmentHint: SSH terminals do not send local environment variables. This host’s SendEnv setting is ignored; the remote shell uses the server’s environment.
screenReaderOutputLimit: Too much terminal output to announce. Navigate to the output to continue reading.
